method: Manual source-level fingerprinting of the ten unrelated slot-07 artifacts; evidence is diagnostic, not a universal style classifier.

recurring_signals.signal: light paper, cream, canvas, or matte surface
moss, sage, forest, teal, green, or navy primary role
coral, rust, clay, amber, citrus, or gold secondary accent
editorial or classic serif prominently paired with restrained sans
calm editorial copy and medium information density
rail, inspector, drawer, or card-grid composition shell

interpretation.supported: Authorial 11.1 produced a highly coherent and attractive cross-task visual prior.
interpretation.risk: Unrelated products may inherit the model's preferred material, palette, typography, and shell rather than deriving them independently from product mechanism or audience scene.
interpretation.not_supported: The repeated choices are individually bad or should be banned.
interpretation.recommended_test: Compare cross-task fingerprints while exempting artifacts with explicit shared brand or design-system authority.

proposed_authorial_12_control.name: Prior Escape
proposed_authorial_12_control.decision_rule: Treat all three as spent unless product mechanism, audience scene, platform authority, established design authority, or explicit preference earns one.
